stories.title: Sensex falls over 100 pts, Nifty below 22,550 as market heads for 8th weekly loss, overtaking COVID crash. More pain ahead?

en.title: Sensex falls over 100 pts, Nifty below 22,550 as market heads for 8th weekly loss, overtaking COVID crash. More pain ahead?
en.summary: Indian stock benchmarks Sensex and Nifty declined for the fourth consecutive day, extending their losing streak to eight weeks. This marks the longest consecutive weekly decline since 2001, surpassing the seven-week downturn during the COVID pandemic, driven by foreign investor outflows and rising US bond yields.
